e.title: IGLN（保险治理领导力网络）：非执行董事与高管的保险董事会专项平台
e.title_en: IGLN (Insurance Governance Leadership Network): an insurance board-level platform for non-executive directors and senior executives
e.title_hk: IGLN（保險治理領導力網絡）：非執行董事與高管的保險董事會專項平台
e.summary: 面向保险业非执行董事与高管的高层对话平台（由 Tapestry Networks 运营）：设审计与控制、新兴技术、金融服务、医疗与「人、文化与诚信」等焦点领域，并出版董事会与金融机构领导层洞察
e.summary_en: A senior-level dialogue platform for insurance non-executive directors and executives (run by Tapestry Networks): it has focus areas in audit and control, emerging technologies, financial services, healthcare, and people, culture and integrity, and publishes boardroom and financial-institution leadership insights
e.summary_hk: 面向保險業非執行董事與高管的高層對話平台（由 Tapestry Networks 運營）：設審計與控制、新興技術、金融服務、醫療與「人、文化與誠信」等焦點領域，並出版董事會與金融機構領導層洞察
e.body:
**IGLN（Insurance Governance Leadership Network，保险治理领导力网络）** 是**面向保险业非执行董事与高管的高层平台**，由 **Tapestry Networks** 运营（站点标题实测 **「Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks」**）。本条目补的是**「保险董事会治理」这一形态**——⭐ **口径必须写明**：**池内已有 [[insurance-governance]] 与 [[three-lines-of-defense]] 两个概念条目、以及 [[cro-forum]]（首席风险官论坛）**，**但「以非执行董事为成员、以董事会为对象的保险专项网络」此前为 0**——**即「有概念、有 CRO 层，没有董事会层」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **IGLN 专页 `/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network` 实测 77.0KB，标题「Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks」**，正文实测写明 **「Insurance Governance Leadership Network」**、**「Navigating change and searching for opportunities」**，并逐字写明其定位：**「The IGLN provides the premier platform for non-executive directors, senior executives, …」**（**面向非执行董事与高级管理人员的平台**，**句子在实测处以省略号截断，词条内只引用到该处为止**）；⭐ **Tapestry 的焦点领域页 `/focus-area/auditcontrol/` 实测 59.0KB，标题「Audit & Control - Tapestry Networks」**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：**Tapestry 主栏目** 含 **Get Involved**、**Who We Are**、**What We Do**、⭐ **Focus Areas**、**News**、**Careers**；⭐ **Focus Areas 实测含五个领域**：**Audit & Control（审计与控制）**、**Emerging Technologies（新兴技术）**、**Financial Services（金融服务）**、**Healthcare（医疗）**、**People, Culture, & Integrity（人、文化与诚信）**；⭐ **出版物实测含** **`/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-boardrooms/`（金融机构董事会洞察）**、**`/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-leaders/`**、**`/publication/navigating-policy-and-market-uncertainty/`**、**`/publication/responding-to-a-heightened-technology-risk-landscape/`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「董事会层」这一治理高度**——**池内治理侧此前是「概念」（[[insurance-governance]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]]）与「CRO 层」（[[cro-forum]]）**，**而 IGLN 补的是**非执行董事**这一层**；**对公司治理与风险管理方向的学生，「谁在董事会上问什么问题」与「CRO 在关心什么」是两套议程**（**可对照阅读：[[cro-forum]] 是按议题组织的 CRO 论坛，IGLN 是按角色组织的董事会网络**）。**② ⭐ 「Audit & Control」被列为独立焦点领域，说明审计委员会是董事会治理的核心议题之一**——**这与同轮 [[theiia]] 的「全球审计委员会中心」正好衔接：一个是董事侧的对话平台，一个是内部审计职业侧的资源中心**。**③ ⭐ 出版物直接以「金融机构董事会洞察」为题**——**即其产出是「把董事会里的讨论抽象成可读洞察」**，**这是一种少见的产出形态**（**可与池内 [[cro-forum]] 的 20 年档案、[[geneva-association]] 的研究报告并读——三者都是行业高层议题的产出，但组织方式不同**）。**④ 「People, Culture & Integrity」这一焦点领域值得注意**——**文化与诚信被当作独立的治理议题**，**与池内 [[aae-ai-act-position]] 等立场文件、[[abcd]] 的职业纪律属不同层面但同一关切**（**本次未打开该领域内容**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**IGLN 专页与一个焦点领域页的存在、标题、页面体量、专页开头的定位表述、以及导航逐字实测的五个焦点领域与四个出版物路径**，**但未打开任何出版物、未打开其余四个焦点领域、未打开 Get Involved / Who We Are / What We Do 等页面**，因此**不能转述任何出版物的内容与结论、IGLN 的成员构成、参与方式、活动形式或议题细节**；**② ⭐ 「面向非执行董事与高管」为**专页正文逐字实测**，**但该句在实测处被截断（以省略号结尾于我的读取窗口）**——**词条内只引用到截断处，不补全其后内容**；**③ 「premier platform」是站点自述措辞**，**本词条如实引用并标注为站点自述，不作评价**；**④ IGLN 与 [[cro-forum]]、与 Tapestry 其他焦点领域的关系本次未核实**——**词条内对两者的对照属阅读建议，不是机构关系主张**；**⑤ Tapestry Networks 的机构性质（咨询/智库/平台运营方）、资金来源与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑥ IGLN 是否对非成员开放、是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** IGLN 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：`/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network`（77.0KB）与 `/focus-area/auditcontrol/`（59.0KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、专页开头与导航；**未打开任何出版物、其余焦点领域或 About 类页面**。
e.body_en:
**IGLN (the Insurance Governance Leadership Network)** is **a senior-level platform for insurance non-executive directors and executives**, run by **Tapestry Networks** (measured site title **"Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks"**). This entry adds the **"insurance board governance"** form — ⭐ **and the scope must be stated**: **the corpus already holds the concepts [[insurance-governance]] and [[three-lines-of-defense]], plus [[cro-forum]] (the Chief Risk Officer Forum)**, **but "an insurance-specific network whose members are non-executive directors and whose subject is the board" measured zero** — **i.e. the concepts and the CRO layer existed, the board layer did not**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **IGLN page `/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network` measures 77.0KB with the measured title "Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks"**, its body measurably reading **"Insurance Governance Leadership Network"**, **"Navigating change and searching for opportunities"**, and stating its positioning verbatim: **"The IGLN provides the premier platform for non-executive directors, senior executives, …"** (**a platform for non-executive directors and senior executives**; **the sentence truncates at my read window, and the entry quotes no further**); ⭐ the **Tapestry focus area page `/focus-area/auditcontrol/` measures 59.0KB with the measured title "Audit & Control - Tapestry Networks"**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: **Tapestry’s main navigation** covers **Get Involved**, **Who We Are**, **What We Do**, ⭐ **Focus Areas**, **News** and **Careers**; ⭐ **Focus Areas measurably contains five areas**: **Audit & Control**, **Emerging Technologies**, **Financial Services**, **Healthcare** and **People, Culture, & Integrity**; ⭐ **measured publications include `/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-boardrooms/`**, **`/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-leaders/`**, **`/publication/navigating-policy-and-market-uncertainty/`** and **`/publication/responding-to-a-heightened-technology-risk-landscape/`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the board level of governance** — **the corpus’s governance side previously held concepts ([[insurance-governance]], [[three-lines-of-defense]]) and the CRO layer ([[cro-forum]])**, **while IGLN adds the non-executive director layer**; **for students of corporate governance and risk management, "what the board asks" and "what the CRO cares about" are two different agendas** (**compare [[cro-forum]], a CRO forum organised by topic, with IGLN, a board network organised by role**). **② ⭐ "Audit & Control" being a standalone focus area shows the audit committee is a core board governance topic** — **which connects to [[theiia]]’s Global Audit Committee Center in the same round: one is the director-side dialogue platform, the other the internal audit profession’s resource centre**. **③ ⭐ A publication titled around financial institution boardroom insights means the output is "boardroom discussion abstracted into readable insight"** — **an uncommon output form** (**readable with the twenty-year archive of [[cro-forum]] and the research reports of [[geneva-association]] — all three produce senior industry-agenda material, organised differently**). **④ The "People, Culture & Integrity" focus area is notable** — **culture and integrity treated as a governance topic in their own right**, **at a different level from but sharing concerns with position papers such as [[aae-ai-act-position]] and the professional discipline of [[abcd]]** (**that area’s content was not opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the IGLN page and one focus area page’s existence, titles and sizes, the positioning statement at the top of the IGLN page, and the five focus areas and four publication paths read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no publication, no other focus area and none of the Get Involved, Who We Are or What We Do pages**, so **no publication content or conclusion, member composition, participation route, activity format or topic detail can be restated**; **② ⭐ "for non-executive directors and executives" is read verbatim from the IGLN page body**, **but that sentence truncates at my read window** — **the entry quotes only to the truncation and completes nothing**; **③ "premier platform" is the site’s own wording**, **quoted as such and attributed to the site with no evaluation**; **④ IGLN’s relationship with [[cro-forum]] or with Tapestry’s other focus areas was not verified** — **the comparison in the entry is a reading suggestion, not a claim about institutional relationships**; **⑤ Tapestry Networks’ institutional nature (advisory, think tank or platform operator), funding and governance were not verified**; **⑥ whether IGLN is open to non-members, and whether Chinese-language material exists, were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim IGLN provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: `/initiatives/insurance-governance-leadership-network` (77.0KB) and `/focus-area/auditcontrol/` (59.0KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, the IGLN page opening and navigation read verbatim; **no publication, other focus area or About-type page was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**IGLN（Insurance Governance Leadership Network，保險治理領導力網絡）** 是**面向保險業非執行董事與高管的高層平台**，由 **Tapestry Networks** 運營（站點標題實測 **「Insurance Governance Leadership Network - Tapestry Networks」**）。本條目補的是**「保險董事會治理」這一形態**——⭐ **口徑必須寫明**：**池內已有 [[insurance-governance]] 與 [[three-lines-of-defense]] 兩個概念條目、以及 [[cro-forum]]（首席風險官論壇）**，**但「以非執行董事為成員、以董事會為對象的保險專項網絡」此前為 0**——**即「有概念、有 CRO 層，沒有董事會層」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **IGLN 專頁 77.0KB**，正文實測含 **「Navigating change and searching for opportunities」**，並逐字寫明定位 **「The IGLN provides the premier platform for non-executive directors, senior executives, …」**（**句子在實測處截斷，詞條內只引用到該處為止**）；⭐ **焦點領域頁 `/focus-area/auditcontrol/` 59.0KB「Audit & Control - Tapestry Networks」**。**導航與連結逐字實測**：⭐ **Focus Areas 實測含五個領域**：**Audit & Control／Emerging Technologies／Financial Services／Healthcare／People, Culture, & Integrity**；⭐ **出版物實測含 `/publication/insights-from-financial-institution-boardrooms/`、`insights-from-financial-institution-leaders`、`navigating-policy-and-market-uncertainty`、`responding-to-a-heightened-technology-risk-landscape`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「董事會層」這一治理高度**——**池內治理側此前是「概念」與「CRO 層」，IGLN 補的是**非執行董事**這一層**；**「誰在董事會上問什麼」與「CRO 在關心什麼」是兩套議程**（**[[cro-forum]] 按議題組織、IGLN 按角色組織**）。**② ⭐ 「Audit & Control」列為獨立焦點領域，說明審計委員會是董事會治理的核心議題之一**——**與同輪 [[theiia]] 的「全球審計委員會中心」正好銜接**。**③ ⭐ 出版物直接以「金融機構董事會洞察」為題**——**即其產出是「把董事會裡的討論抽象成可讀洞察」，是一種少見的產出形態**。**④ 「People, Culture & Integrity」值得注意**——**文化與誠信被當作獨立的治理議題**（**未打開該領域內容**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**IGLN 專頁與一個焦點領域頁的存在、標題、體量、專頁開頭的定位表述、導航逐字實測的五個焦點領域與四個出版物路徑**，**但未打開任何出版物、其餘焦點領域或 About 類頁面**，故**不能轉述任何出版物內容、成員構成、參與方式、活動形式或議題細節**；**② ⭐ 該定位句在實測處被截斷，詞條內只引用到截斷處**；**③ 「premier platform」為站點自述措辭，如實引用並標註，不作評價**；**④ 與 [[cro-forum]] 及 Tapestry 其他焦點領域的關係未核實**——**詞條內的對照屬閱讀建議**；**⑤ Tapestry Networks 的機構性質、資金來源與治理結構未核實**；**⑥ 是否對非成員開放、是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** IGLN 提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：兩個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題、專頁開頭與導航；**未打開任何出版物、其餘焦點領域或 About 類頁面**。
